claims: Usher and Chris Brown have announced "The R&B Tour" (also referred to as The Raymond & Brown Tour) for 2026.
The R&B Tour is a 33-date co-headlining stadium tour across North America.
The R&B Tour kicks off on June 26, 2026, at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, CO.
The R&B Tour concludes on December 11, 2026, at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, FL.
The R&B Tour features major stops in Los Angeles, New York, and Toronto.
The R&B Tour has key stops in Detroit on July 2-3, 2026.
The R&B Tour has key stops in Washington, D.C. on July 10-11, 2026.
The R&B Tour has key stops in East Rutherford/NYC on Aug 7-8, 2026.
The R&B Tour has key stops in Los Angeles.
The R&B Tour has key stops in Atlanta.
General on-sale for The R&B Tour begins April 27, 2026, via Ticketmaster.
Citi presales for The R&B Tour start April 21, 2026.
Artist presales for The R&B Tour are on April 23, 2026.
Usher and Chris Brown have previously collaborated on tracks like "New Flame".
Usher and Chris Brown have previously collaborated on tracks like "Party".
The R&B Tour is partnering with Global Citizen to donate $1 per ticket to the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund.
